description: In the fixed ambient model universe, for every actual quantifier-free scoped matrix, the executable universal matrix test accepts exactly when its actual universally quantified sentence is valid over nonempty structures.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.universalMatrixTest_correct.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Relations n)] {n : ℕ} (A : L.BoundedFormula Empty n)
  (hA : A.IsQF) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.universalMatrixTest A = true ↔
    ∀ (M : Type u) (inst : L.Structure M), Nonempty M → M ⊨ A.alls
